newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold, Knights caution holders.
newsitem.headline: Randgold, Knights caution holders.

text.p: Randgold & Exploration Company Ltd and Knights Gold Mining Company said on Monday talks referred to in earlier published cautioneries were still in progress.

The talks relate to the formation of a new company Newco which would be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, the acquisition by Newco of Knight's assets and RMP Properties Ltd's land clearing and gold recovery operations.
The companies said negotiations regarding the RMP acquisition should be finalised during July and an announcement regarding the Knight's acquisition would be made shortly.
Shareholders were urged to continue to exercice caution in their sharedealings.
